t.why: A NATO member bordering Russia, with a large Russian-speaking minority that makes language and citizenship sensitive issues.
t.rel: One of the three Baltic states bordering Russia. About a quarter of the population is ethnic Russian, making language and citizenship sensitive issues.
t.know: Its song and dance festival, held every five years with tens of thousands of singers, is on UNESCO's cultural heritage list.
t.etext: Timber, logistics and food processing are the main industries. As transit trade with Russia has dwindled, it is restructuring its economy.
